Blackberry Cream Shake
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, April 27, 2010 - 1:40am

Ingredients




1 cup Cold skim milk
1 pkt (4-serving size) JELL-O Brand Blackberry Flavor Sugar-Free 1 cup Vanilla ice milk *
1 cup Crushed ice
1/2 cup Blackberries

Preparation

1 * Recipe calls for ice milk but diabetics would be better served to use a SF frozen dairy dessert instead. 2 Pour milk into blender container. Add remaining ingredients; cover. Blend at high speed 30 seconds or until smooth. 3 Makes 3 1/2cups or 3 servings. 4 1.
